title: SB-023 — Kildeverket 0.2 compiler: parse ratified markup, emit contract-compatible artifacts

context.setupNotes:
## Design summary
A new compiler for markup 0.2 replaces the parse layer of scripts/blueprint/generate-tiny-olsen-case.mjs. The core is a pure ESM module: text in, { slice, labContent, diagnostics } out. No filesystem access in the core. Both the node CLI (`npm run gen:olsen`) and Vite browser code must import it unmodified — the SB-025 script-editor probe and the SB-026 canvas probe render compiler output live. Plain .js with JSDoc types or .ts with a node-compatible loader is the executor's choice, but plain `node` must keep running the CLI. Suggested home: src/compiler/ (parser, emitter, diagnostics), thin CLI wrapper in scripts/blueprint/.

## Spec sources (authority order)
1. docs/markup-0.2-reference.md — Task 1 vendors it from the handoff zip (~/Downloads/Dialog Tree Editor Mockups-handoff.zip → dialog-tree-editor-mockups/project/Markup Reference.dc.html). Until then read the zip.
2. The four ruling comments on SB-022 (1a, 1b, 2, 3) plus DD-001, DD-002, TERM-001.
3. Research findings: SB-020 comment (runtime gap audit — the construct-by-construct warn list), SB-021 comment (drift inventory — the full field map).

## Emit contract
- Target JSON: ../lifelines-core-loop/resources/cases/olsen/source/tiny_olsen_slice.json. The serializer must use TAB indentation — the shipped file is tab-indented (SB-313/SB-486 canonical formatting); the old generator's 2-space JSON.stringify does NOT match. tinyOlsen.ts keeps the current prettier formatting path.
- Sparse-field law (ruling 3): omit unset fields. Authored zero is explicit — weight, max_value, ck_grete's good_segment_size 0 vs the old default 4. Never re-add visit_hour.
- [icon=coin] tokens (26 occurrences) pass through the markdown→bbcode pass untouched.
- Question reveal is one-way (ruling 3): `when:` on the question owns it. Drop the old generator's bidirectional Reveals-questions↔Opens-when check.
- Field map (0.2 → JSON): `Deadline: day N` → vurdering_frist_day. `arrives: day N on ck_x` on a document → a day_script_beats queue_pending_document effect, never a document field (clock_id is a bucket key, not a tick). Fact block: `Frank: «…»` → frank_response, `Card: «…»` → card_line, `About:` → about, `Reveals: call:grete` → reveals_event (namespaced handle kept). Question block: `Card title:`/`Card sub:` → card_title/card_sub, `Teaser:` → teaser (blank allowed — q_baering is deliberately ""). Dispatch: `Activity: «…»` → activity_title, Channel/Delay/Duration/Occupies/Reception → channel/channel_delay_minutes/duration_h/occupies_hours/reception_modifier. Clock: `Max: N` → max_value (nullable — omit the line, omit the field). Hypothesis `Opens:` bracket payload `c_frank_okonomi [risk=okonomi type=… actor=…]` → open_conversation effect whose metadata keys sit OUTSIDE args (type, category, actor, risk_tags, sim_hook_id) — match the shipped h_ok_gap shape exactly.
- DD-002 boundary: emit only what the runtime plays. Everything else parses, validates, and warns — never emits speculative JSON. The structured warning list doubles as the engine backlog.

## Cautions
- NEVER run write-mode `npm run gen:olsen` while content/cases/olsen/tiny-olsen.case.md is still 0.1 content: the write would overwrite 35 drifted core-loop commits in tiny_olsen_slice.json. Use --check mode and in-memory tests only. SB-024 heals the content.
- Expected end state of this plan: `npm run gen:olsen:check` finds tinyOlsen.ts up to date and still reports the core JSON stale. That red is the SB-024 content drift, not a compiler bug. Record the exact message in the final progress note.
- Never edit .pm/data files directly — pm CLI only.
- Old sections stay parseable: the current 0.1 file must compile (with fix-it diagnostics), because Task 5 proves equivalence against the old generator on that file.

## SDD Deviations
1. MECHANISM_DEVIATION: proposals are excluded from this plan.
   - Source says: ruling 1b — `# Proposal: f_a + f_b`, 24 blocks accepted.
   - Plan does: no proposal parsing or emit. The shipped frank_proposals have relevant_fact_ids of arity 1–3 and some key on relevant_categories, which a pair header cannot express. Gate ticket SB-028 asks Terje to re-ratify; SB-029 (blocked by SB-028) implements afterwards.
   - Reason: never guess ratified syntax. Requires human decision: yes — filed as SB-028.
2. MECHANISM_DEVIATION: leads emit shape.
   - Source says: ruling 3 kills the three-shape leads union; markup form is `Lead: «label» -> target`.
   - Plan does: the emitter writes one canonical JSON object per lead (label + target id, target any tiltak or dispatch id). Byte-equality with the shipped heterogeneous leads is impossible by design; the leads golden asserts the canonical shape instead. Core-loop reader IOU filed as GAP-001.
   - Reason: the ruling fixed the markup, not the JSON; one canonical emit is the only shape consistent with it. Requires human decision: no.
3. Beat ids: the shipped beats carry authored ids (beat_grete_d2); the §5 `# Beat: day 5` header has none. Derive stable ids unless core-loop references beat ids elsewhere — in that case support an optional id in the header and record the extension in the progress note.

## Judge-rung justification
Every surface in this plan is compiler machinery — Track V end to end. The designer-visible surfaces (editor, canvas) are SB-025/SB-026 probes, outside this plan, so no screenshot rung is required here. The pipeline floor for case-content work is held by Task 5 (`npm run gen:olsen:check` + the equivalence suite).

## Implementation slices
Slice 1 — Task 1: compiler core + entity emit. Evidence: fixture tests whose golden fragments are copied verbatim from tiny_olsen_slice.json.
Slice 2 — Tasks 2–3: conversation weave + declarative blocks. Same evidence style.
Slice 3 — Task 4: §9 graph lints. Evidence: trigger/silent fixture pairs.
Slice 4 — Task 5: legacy equivalence, emit stability golden, CLI wiring. Evidence: npm test + gen:olsen:check.
designDecisions: DD-001: hybrid conversation layer — flow gets weave with card-keyed branches (TERM-001), matching (recipes, proposals, pair lines) stays declarative.
DD-002: emit boundary = runtime capability. Unplayable weave parses and warns, never emits JSON.
SB-022 ruling 3: sparse-field law, one-way question reveal, single canonical Lead form, §10 field addenda.
Stubs are never fatal; TODO: lines are tracked work; the file always compiles (0.2 reference law).
Canonical core-loop JSON is tab-indented; the compiler's serializer matches it.

tasks.title: Task 1: Compiler core — block parser, §6 condition grammar, §7 effect lines, entity emit
tasks.description: Stand up the pure compiler module: compileCase(text) → { slice, labContent, diagnostics }. Coverage: §1 case header (Title/Stage/Deadline, pair-line fields arrive in Task 3), §2 documents with anchors and `arrives:` (compiles to a day_script_beats effect), §3 facts (## blocks under a document inherit it as source; standalone facts declare Source:; ~ effect lines; Frank:/Card:/About:/Reveals: fields), §4 questions (Teaser, when:, canonical Lead lines, Card title/sub), hypotheses (needs:, Opens: incl. the bracket metadata payload → open_conversation with keys outside args), tiltak (Weight sparse), §5 dispatches (Channel/Delay/Duration/Occupies/Reception/Activity, gate:, ~ deliver), clocks (Good/Bad `label / N` form, Max nullable, visible when:, authored 0 distinct from unset), beats (# Beat: day N, prose, ~ lines). One §6 grammar everywhere a gate appears: and/or/not/parens/n of; terms fact, tiltak (taken), question (open), dispatch (done), ck >= N, day >= N, stage, asked.*. Emit PredicateSpec for ops the runtime has; a structured warning for terms it lacks (SB-020 table: tiltak-taken, question-open, dispatch-done, ck>=N, day>=N-in-weave, n of). §7 effects → EffectSpec (~ pay, ~ clock, ~ deliver [in Nd] [on ck], ~ open, ~ stage, ~ log). Diagnostics are one typed contract shared by warnings, stubs, TODOs and fix-its: { code, severity, message, span, subjectIds } with stable codes and line spans — this is the editor's consumption surface (SB-023 acceptance). Stubs (any unresolved id) are never fatal. // comments are stripped. Also vendor the spec: extract the Markup Reference from the handoff zip into docs/markup-0.2-reference.md and append pointers to the four SB-022 rulings. Out of scope: weave (# Conversation:), recipes, proposals, graph lints.
steps: Vendor docs/markup-0.2-reference.md from the handoff zip; keep the section numbering; append a 'Rulings' section pointing at SB-022 comments 1a/1b/2/3, DD-001, DD-002.

Write fixture tests first: one 0.2 fixture per construct family, with expected fragments copied verbatim from tiny_olsen_slice.json where the shipped case exercises the construct (e.g. h_ok_gap's open_conversation, ck_grete's zero segment, a beat with a deliver effect). Confirm they fail red before the implementation.
Implement the pure module (suggested: src/compiler/parse, emit, diagnostics) until the fixtures pass.
Implement the §6 grammar as one parser reused by when:/needs:/gate:/visible when:, with the runtime-capability warning split per SB-020.
Run npm test and npm run lint.
tasks.verification: judge: test. command: npm test && npm run lint. proves: 0.2 entity constructs parse and emit runtime-shaped fragments equal to the shipped ones, and diagnostics carry stable codes with line spans. fake_evidence: snapshot tests of the compiler's own output, or expected fragments retyped by hand instead of copied from the core-loop JSON — both would go green on a wrong emitter.

tasks.title: Task 2: Conversation weave — card-keyed branches, DD-002 emit boundary, calls + frank_chat emit
tasks.description: Parse # Conversation: blocks per §8 and rulings 1a/2. A top-level branch is card-keyed (TERM-001: `* f_x:` fires when the player plays card f_x); indented lines under it are the reply, with speaker tags (who: 'du') and liftable spans (fact_id on a line, authored as anchors). One-deep `* *` follow-ups are once-only. Guards per surface (ruling 2): calls take full PredicateSpec (facts + stage), chat entries take a flat AND fact list (needs), follow-ups take no guard — a guard there is a structured warning. ~ effect lines legal in branches (`~ pay` mints a fact → pays_fact on chat entries). Soft reject is declarative, not `* ->`. Emit: the calls array (contact_id, gate, opening lines, soft_reject, exchanges keyed by card_id with ask + reply) and frank_chat entries (id, question, answer AND answer_lines both populated as shipped, needs, followups with label + lines, pays_fact) — contract-compatible with the shipped shapes. WARN, never emit (ruling 2 list): nesting deeper than one, gathers `- (hub)`, diverts `-> x`, `-> END`, `* ->` fallback, `{a|b}` sequences, `(label)`/asked.* counts, `n of` in weave guards, guard terms with no runtime op. Each warning is a structured diagnostic — this list is the engine backlog. §10 compat: Question/Answer/Needs triples compile as one-choice weaves if present in a source.
steps: Write golden fixtures first: a 0.2 weave whose emit equals calls[0] (the Grete call — opening with speaker tag and mid-call fact lift, three exchanges, soft reject) and 0.2 weaves for frank_chat entries c_post (followups), c_avstand (pays_fact via ~ pay) and c_dor_glott (empty legacy answer, answer_lines primary), all expected values copied verbatim from tiny_olsen_slice.json. Red first.
Implement the weave parser and the two surface emitters until green.
Add one fixture per warn-list construct asserting: parses, emits nothing for that construct, produces the expected diagnostic code.
Run npm test && npm run lint.

tasks.title: Task 4: §9 warning set — graph lints as structured diagnostics
tasks.description: The seven §9 lints, computed on the compiled case graph, emitted through the same diagnostics contract as Task 1 (stable codes, subject ids, spans where a source line exists): facts without a source anchor · questions with no path to a tiltak · hypotheses that open nothing · conversations with no way back to the hub (loose ends) · gates referencing undeliverable facts (a fact no document anchor, weave line, or effect can ever pay) · quiet days (no document arrival, beat, or newly-satisfiable gate lands on a day inside the deadline window) · clocks that can never become visible. Reachability definitions the executor pins down must land in docs/markup-0.2-reference.md next to the vendored spec, so the lint semantics are written where the next author looks. These lints are advisory severity — they never block compilation (the file always compiles).
steps: For each lint: write a minimal fixture that triggers it and a healthy sibling fixture that stays silent. Red first.
Implement the graph passes until all pairs behave.
Run the full compiler suite on the current 0.1 tiny-olsen.case.md and eyeball the lint output for absurdities (a lint firing on all 27 facts is a definition bug, not content truth).
Document each lint's exact definition in docs/markup-0.2-reference.md.
Run npm test && npm run lint.
tasks.verification: judge: test. command: npm test && npm run lint. proves: each §9 lint fires on its trigger fixture and stays silent on its healthy sibling, at advisory severity. fake_evidence: lints tested only on trigger fixtures — without the silent sibling, an always-firing lint looks correct.

progressNotes.text: Task 4 complete. BUILT: the seven §9 graph lints as src/compiler/lints.ts (runLints), wired from emit.ts end-of-emitCase; weave.ts WeaveResult gains a spans map (call:<contact> + chat entry ids -> conversation block span); diagnostics.ts gains a fourth Severity 'advisory' (lints never block; softer than warning) and 7 stable codes: lint-fact-no-source-anchor, lint-question-no-tiltak-path, lint-hypothesis-opens-nothing, lint-conversation-loose-end, lint-gate-undeliverable-fact, lint-quiet-day, lint-clock-never-visible. emit.ts collects GateSite[] (the four bindCondition sites: question when, hypothesis needs, dispatch gate, clock visible when) and TiltakGate[] (0.1 Needs/Needs hypothesis) plus a block-id->span map and the Deadline span, then calls runLints. DEFINITIONS (documented in docs/markup-0.2-reference.md 'Compiler extensions recorded by TASK-017', kept in sync with lints.ts): shared deliverability = fact payable via document run anchor, call-line lift (fact_id), chat ~ pay (pays_fact), or event-delta reveal_fact_id — card-keyed branches CONSUME facts, never pay. L1 declared+unpayable fact. L2 no direct tiltak path (Lead->t_, hypothesis open_tiltak, or 0.1 tiltak Needs-hypothesis direction; a recipe's ~ open is a path INTO the question per TASK-016 and does not count; dispatch transitivity not followed).
